label: Introduced the paradigm shift model to explain discontinuous revolutionary ruptures in scientific history
description: Thomas Kuhn formulated and introduced the concept of "Paradigm Shift & Scientific Revolutions", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Thomas Kuhn's canonical writings.

label: Defined normal science as cumulative puzzle-solving conducted within an unchallenged paradigm
description: Thomas Kuhn formulated and introduced the concept of "Normal Science & Puzzle-Solving", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Thomas Kuhn's canonical writings.

label: Articulated semantic and taxonomic incommensurability between successive scientific paradigms
description: Thomas Kuhn formulated and introduced the concept of "Incommensurability", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Thomas Kuhn's canonical writings.

label: Kuhn's historicist critique of cumulative science and paradigm shifts paralleled and informed Foucault's archaeology of epistemes
description: Michel Foucault was fundamentally influenced by Thomas Kuhn's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Thomas Kuhn's perspective to Michel Foucault's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.

dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Thomas Kuhn's perspective to Jürgen Habermas's reconstructed system.
